title: Backend service
description: Add an unfinished Spring service to an existing backend module. Example: pnpm nx g @theparlor/backend-tools:backend-service --module=inventory --name=stock-pricing --method=quote --dry-run --no-interactive

module.description: Existing Spring Modulith module, such as inventory. Does not create a new module.

name.description: PascalCase or kebab-case service name; Service is appended if absent.

interfaceName.description: Optional public module interface name, e.g. StockPricing. Existing files are never overwritten.

method.description: Name of the void placeholder method. Replace its signature with domain-specific inputs/outputs.

write.description: Add a write transaction to the placeholder method; otherwise it inherits readOnly=true.
